from itertools import permutations

def is_costas(perm):
    n = len(perm)
    vectors = set()
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i+1, n):
            dc = j - i
            dr = perm[j] - perm[i]
            vec = (dr, dc)
            if vec in vectors:
                return False
            vectors.add(vec)
    return True

# Search all permutations of order 6
n = 6
for perm in permutations(range(n)):
    if is_costas(perm):
        print(f"Found Costas array: {list(perm)}")
        # Verify
        vectors = []
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(i+1, n):
                dc = j - i
                dr = perm[j] - perm[i]
                vectors.append((dr, dc))
        print(f"Number of displacement vectors: {len(vectors)}")
        print(f"All distinct: {len(vectors) == len(set(vectors))}")
        break
